description: Basecamp 3/4 REST API client wrapper. Every request is scoped under a per-account URL (https://3.basecampapi.com/<account_id>/...); auth is an OAuth2 Bearer access token obtained via a 3-legged authorization-code grant.

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Key used to register this resource. Other components reference it via resource_key.

account_id.label: Account Id
account_id.description: Basecamp account ID (numeric segment after the host in any Basecamp URL).

access_token_env_var.label: Access Token Env Var
access_token_env_var.description: Env var holding a Basecamp OAuth2 access token.

user_agent.label: User Agent
user_agent.description: User-Agent header value sent on every request.
